reason: A defines a compositionally closed intervention—partial Mo-for-Nb substitution—and directly tests whether plastic strain increases while yield strength stays within 10% of 1719 MPa and the disordered BCC phase is retained. It is better supported by prior results showing the Mo strength–ductility trade-off and Nb’s ductility benefit, whereas B leaves the compensating compositional change unspecified and therefore confounds Mo reduction with changes in total composition.
